outlooks.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED STORMS PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS...HAIL...AND FEW TORNADOES WILL BE POSSIBLE FROM EASTERN MONTANA...NORTHEAST WYOMING...AND THE WESTERN DAKOTAS INTO THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES. DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS ACROSS LOWER MICHIGAN AND NORTHERN INDIANA TO CENTRAL PENNSYLVANIA AND WESTERN NEW YORK. ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE IN THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: LARGE SCALE MID-UPPER LEVEL TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP OVER THE WRN U.S. WITH A MIDLEVEL CLOSED LOW SHIFTING SLOWLY EWD THROUGH THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST INTO WRN MT THIS FORECAST PERIOD. EAST OF THE ROCKIES...HEIGHT RISES ARE EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF THE MID MO VALLEY AND THE UPPER MIDWEST. MEANWHILE...A MIDLEVEL IMPULSE IS EXPECTED TO TRACK EWD ACROSS LOWER MI THIS AFTERNOON AND INTO THE LOWER GREAT LAKES BY EARLY EVENING. MODELS INCLUDING THE ECMWF AGREE WITH AN UPSTREAM IMPULSE EMANATING FROM THE BASE OF THE WRN TROUGH WILL REACH THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS BY 12Z TODAY. THIS FEATURE IS EXPECTED TO MOVE NEWD INTO ERN NEB/WRN IA BY LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND THEN TURN EWD ACROSS WI AND LOWER MI THIS EVENING AND TONIGHT. AT THE SURFACE...A WARM FRONT IS EXPECTED TO MOVE NWD INTO LOWER MI...SRN WI AND SRN MN...WHILE THE WRN PORTION OF THIS BOUNDARY STRETCHES FROM SERN SD WNWWD INTO WRN SD AND ERN MT. A LEE TROUGH WILL EXTEND SWD FROM ERN MT/WY...WHILE A COLD FRONT ADVANCES EWD THROUGH MT/WY AND NWRN CO. A VERY MOIST ENVIRONMENT CURRENTLY RESIDING ACROSS ERN NEB TO IL WITH PRECIPITABLE WATER VALUES AT OR ABOVE 1.5 INCHES IS EXPECTED TO EXPAND NWD ACROSS MORE OF THE UPPER MS VALLEY A

sections.title: ERN MT/NERN WY/WRN ND/WRN AND CENTRAL SD
sections.text: ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS ACROSS THE DAKOTAS INTO FAR ERN MT AND NERN WY WILL ADVECT MOISTURE WWD WITH SURFACE DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50S TO LOWER 60S EXPECTED BY LATE AFTERNOON INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS AND ERN MT/NERN WY. THIS COMBINED WITH VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /8-8.5 C PER KM/ EXPECTED ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS WILL CONTRIBUTE TO MODERATE-STRONG INSTABILITY. THE EVOLUTION OF THE UPPER FLOW PATTERN TODAY WILL SUPPORT A DIFLUENT FLOW REGIME ACROSS ERN MT/WY INTO THE WRN DAKOTAS. THIS COMBINED WITH THE EXIT REGION OF 50-60 KT 500 MB JET SPREADING ACROSS WY INTO ERN MT AND 30-40 KT ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS INTO THE LEE TROUGH IN MT/WY WILL RESULT IN AN INCREASE IN DEEP LAYER ASCENT. THIS WILL SUPPORT STORM INITIATION INVOF THE SURFACE BOUNDARIES AND THE HIGHER TERRAIN INCLUDING THE BLACK HILLS BY THIS AFTERNOON. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 40-60 KT WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH ALL SEVERE HAZARDS EXPECTED. STORMS THAT CAN REMAIN DISCRETE WILL HAVE THE GREATEST POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE A TORNADO...WHILE VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH INITIAL STORMS. BOWING LINE SEGMENTS CAN BE EXPECTED AS WELL.

sections.title: NERN NEB/SERN SD/IA/SRN MN/WI/NRN IL
sections.text: AN EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /MLCAPE 3500-4500 J PER KG/ IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF THE MID MO AND UPPER MS VALLEYS. MIDLEVEL HEIGHT RISES AND A CAP ARE EXPECTED TO LIMIT SURFACE-BASED DEVELOPMENT INTO THE MID-LATE AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE ERN CO IMPULSE AND LOW-LEVEL WAA INVOF A LEFTOVER CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM SRN IA TO NERN NEB AND NEAR THE WARM FRONT SHOULD SUPPORT TSTM DEVELOPMENT BY LATE AFTERNOON ACROSS THIS REGION. GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND STRONG BULK SHEAR /45-55 KT/...VERY LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH ANY OF THE INITIAL...DISCRETE STORMS. WHILE THERE IS SOME MODEL UNCERTAINTY IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF THIS INITIAL ACTIVITY...THE EXPECTED TIMING OF THE ERN CO IMPULSE BY PEAK HEATING SUGGESTS A SLIGHT RISK IS WARRANTED INCLUDING THE POTENTIAL FOR SIGNIFICANT HAIL. A SWLY LLJ EXTENDING INTO IA/SRN MN TO SRN WI AND NRN IL THIS EVENING THROUGH THE OVERNIGHT/EARLY WEDNESDAY SUGGESTS THE POTENTIAL FOR UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE MCS/S WITH DAMAGING WINDS BECOMING THE PRIMARY THREAT...THOUGH HAIL AND A TORNADO THREAT CANNOT BE RULED OUT.

sections.title: SRN GREAT LAKES TO CENTRAL PA/WRN NY
sections.text: AT 12Z...AN MCS /POTENTIALLY PRODUCING SOME STRONGER WIND GUSTS/ SHOULD BE LOCATED FROM WRN LOWER MI INTO NRN PARTS OF IND/IL. SURFACE HEATING DOWNSTREAM OF THIS SYSTEM WITHIN THE EXPECTED CORRIDOR OF MOISTURE ADVECTION INTO THE UPPER OH VALLEY/LOWER GREAT LAKES AND ERN EXTENT OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /7-7.5 C PER KM/ WILL SUPPORT A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS /MLCAPE 1500-2000 J PER KG/. REDEVELOPMENT ALONG THE ERN PERIPHERY OF THE MORNING MCS AND/OR NEW TSTM FORMATION WILL BE POSSIBLE INVOF THE WARM FRONT WITH STRONG/DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL BEING THE PRIMARY THREATS AS ACTIVITY SPREADS E/SEWD. CURRENT THINKING SUGGESTS STORMS WILL AFFECT SERN LOWER MI THROUGH PARTS OF NRN OH INTO NWRN AND CENTRAL PA...AND WRN NY PERHAPS AS EARLY AS LATE MORNING...AND MORE LIKELY FROM AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. ..PETERS.. 06/17/2014

outlooks.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND...HAIL...AND FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM EASTERN MONTANA...NORTHEAST WYOMING...AND THE WESTERN DAKOTAS INTO THE UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS WITH STORMS FROM LOWER MICHIGAN AND NORTHERN INDIANA EASTWARD INTO PENNSYLVANIA AND NEW YORK. ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MAY OCCUR OVER THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: SYNOPTIC SETUP
sections.text: SEASONABLY STRONG UPR LOW WILL CONTINUE TO EDGE SLOWLY E ACROSS THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION THIS PERIOD AS AN ASSOCIATED SPEED MAX/SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOW OVER NE CA REACHES THE NV-UT BORDER THIS EVE...AND THEN TURNS NNE INTO WY EARLY WED. DOWNSTREAM FROM THE LOW...MODERATE SW TO WSWLY FLOW WILL PREVAIL FROM THE CNTRL AND NRN PLNS THROUGH THE UPR MS VLY INTO THE LWR GRT LKS/NEW ENGLAND. CONVECTIVELY-ENHANCED DISTURBANCE WITHIN THIS FLOW...NOW OVER LK MI...SHOULD CONTINUE E TO UPSTATE NY THIS EVE AND OFF THE ME CST EARLY WED. SLIGHT HEIGHT RISES ARE EXPECTED ACROSS THE NRN HALF OF THE PLNS IN THE WAKE OF THE LK MI IMPULSE. SATELLITE AND VWP DATA DO...HOWEVER...SUGGEST PRESENCE OF AN ADDITIONAL IMPULSE NOW OVER ERN CO/NE NM THAT WILL CONTINUE NE INTO ERN NEB/WRN IA THIS EVE...AND INTO WI EARLY WED. THE LWR LVLS WILL BE DOMINATED BY PERSISTENT...NEARLY STNRY LEE CYCLONE OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLNS. A DIFFUSE FRONT EXTENDING ESE FROM ERN WY INTO THE MID/UPR MS VLY SHOULD REMAIN MORE OR LESS STNRY THROUGH THE PERIOD...WITH ITS EFFECTIVE LOCATION INTERMITTENTLY SHIFTED SWD IN PLACES BY MCS OUTFLOW.

sections.title: LWR MI/GRT LKS TODAY INTO TNGT
sections.text: BAND OF SEASONABLY STRONG /40-50 KT/...LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WSWLY FLOW ON SRN FRINGE OF LK MI UPR IMPULSE WILL SWEEP E INTO THE LWR GRT LKS/WRN NEW ENGLAND BY EARLY TNGT...ACCOMPANIED BY AN APPRECIABLE INCREASE IN MOISTURE /PW 1.50-1.75 INCHES/. LOW-LVL CONVERGENCE ACROSS REGION WILL REMAIN WEAK...DOMINATED BY LAKE BREEZE BOUNDARIES IN UPSTATE NY/NW PA AND...POSSIBLY...BY CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW IN LWR MI. COMBINATION OF MODERATE TO STRONG SFC HEATING /ESPECIALLY IN NY/ WITH INCREASING MOISTURE SHOULD BOOST SBCAPE TO BETWEEN 1500 AND 2500 J/KG. COUPLED WITH EXPECTED LOW TO MID-TROPOSPHERIC WIND PROFILES...SETUP MAY PROVE FAVORABLE FOR STORMS ORGANIZED INTO FAST-MOVING...FORWARD-PROPAGATING LINE SEGMENTS WITH DMGG WIND. WHILE THE GREATEST SVR THREAT SHOULD EXIST FROM SE LWR MI EWD THROUGH SW ON INTO NW PA AND UPSTATE NY THROUGH THIS AFTN...A MORE LIMITED THREAT FOR SVR WEATHER MAY CONTINUE INTO THIS EVE AS FAR E/SE AS NJ AND SRN NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: MID/LWR MO VLY THROUGH MID MS VLY TODAY THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: EXPANSIVE OVERNIGHT MCS HAS LEFT A COMPLEX SERIES OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES THAT ATTM EXTENDS WSW FROM NRN IL THROUGH NRN MO INTO SE NEB. FROM THAT POINT THE COMPOSITE BOUNDARIES MERGE WITH SYNOPTIC WARM/STNRY FRONT THAT CONTINUES GENERALLY WNW INTO NE WY. DEEP WIND PROFILES WILL NOT BE AS FAVORABLE FOR FOCUSED/SUSTAINED STORM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE REGION AS WAS THE CASE YESTERDAY...AND LOW-LVL CONVERGENCE WILL BE COMPARATIVELY WEAK AS STRONGEST BAND OF LOW-LVL FLOW CONTINUES ENE AHEAD LK MI UPR IMPULSE. NEVERTHELESS...SUFFICIENT /30-35 KT/ SW TO WLY DEEP SHEAR WILL BE PRESENT FOR SUSTAINED STORMS/SUPERCELLS. AT THE SAME TIME...A SIZABLE RESERVOIR OF GREAT POTENTIAL INSTABILITY...WITH SBCAPE AROUND 5000 J/KG...LIKELY WILL DEVELOP WITH DAYTIME HEATING FROM NRN/ERN NEB AND NE KS ENE INTO CNTRL/NRN IL AND SRN WI. EML CAP AND MODEST CONVERGENCE SUGGEST THAT STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY REMAIN ISOLD TO WDLY SCTD THROUGH MUCH OF THE DAY. SOME DEGREE OF LARGE SCALE ASCENT MAY...HOWEVER...BOOST DEVELOPMENT LATER TODAY AS CO/NM UPR IMPULSE CONTINUES NEWD. ANY STORMS THAT DO FORM WILL BE CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL...LOCALLY DMGG WIND...AND TORNADOES. MORE WIDESPREAD STORM DEVELOPMENT...WITH LIKELY EVO

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLNS TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: MOIST /PW AROUND 1.25 INCHES/ ESELY LOW-LVL FLOW WILL PERSIST THROUGH TNGT ALONG AND N OF FRONT STALLED ROUGHLY WNW-ESE FROM ERN WY INTO WRN SD/NRN NEB. AT THE SAME TIME...MODERATE S TO SWLY FLOW WILL PREVAIL ALOFT...DOWNSTREAM FROM INTERMOUNTAIN REGION UPR LOW. AN IDENTIFIABLE SHORTWAVE IMPULSE IN THE MID/UPR-LVL FLOW TO ENHANCE PROSPECTS FOR ORGANIZED STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE REGION IS NOT APPARENT AT THE MOMENT IN SATELLITE OR MODEL DATA. IN FACT...THE UPR LVL FLOW MAY SOMEWHAT BACK AS THE INTERMOUNTAIN LOW APPROACHES FROM THE WEST. BUT...GIVEN THE QUALITY OF MOISTURE INFLOW...THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE TO STRONG LOW-LVL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR /SIZABLE AND CURVED LOW-LVL HODOGRAPHS/...AND THE LIKELIHOOD FOR MODERATE SFC HEATING...WEAK FRONTAL CONVERGENCE/UPSLOPE FLOW COULD YIELD SCTD DISCRETE SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF TORNADOES IN ADDITION TO LARGE HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND FROM WRN SD NWWD INTO NE WY/SE MT AND SW ND. ..CORFIDI/MARSH.. 06/17/2014

outlooks.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND...VERY LARGE HAIL...AND FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM EASTERN MONTANA...NORTHEAST WYOMING...AND THE WESTERN DAKOTAS INTO THE MIDWEST. DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS WITH STORMS FROM THE GREAT LAKES TO WESTERN NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A MID TO UPPER-LEVEL LOW AND ASSOCIATED WRN U.S. TROUGH WILL BEGIN TO SHIFT EWD DURING THE DAY ONE PERIOD IN RESPONSE TO THE PROGRESSION OF A 55-65 KT JET STREAK AT 500 MB FROM THE TROUGH BASE INTO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. ELSEWHERE...A SHORT-WAVE TROUGH OVER THE UPPER GREAT LAKES WILL DE-AMPLIFY AS IT TRANSLATES EWD THROUGH NEW ENGLAND TONIGHT. AT THE SURFACE...A LEE CYCLONE OVER WRN NEB MAY GRADUALLY DEVELOP NWD TOWARD THE NEB-SD BORDER WITH AN INVERTED TROUGH OR QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT EXTENDING NWWD INTO ERN MT. A BAROCLINIC ZONE WILL ALSO STRETCH EWD FROM THE NEB LOW THROUGH THE MID MO VALLEY AND UPPER MIDWEST WHERE IT WILL LINK WITH A MIGRATORY SURFACE LOW DEVELOPING FROM NRN LAKE MI INTO NRN NEW ENGLAND BY 18/12Z.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: THE 12Z RAPID CITY SOUNDING SAMPLED A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH A LOWEST-100-MB MEAN-MIXING RATIO OF 13 G/KG SURMOUNTED BY A 700-500-MB LAPSE RATE OF 8.5 C/KM WITH A SIMILAR ENVIRONMENT LIKELY EXTENDING NWWD ALONG THE STALLED FRONT INTO SERN MT. DAYTIME HEATING COUPLED WITH THE HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD MODERATE TO STRONG AFTERNOON INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE APPROACHING 1000-2000 J/KG OVER ERN MT TO 2000-3000 J/KG OVER WRN SD. PERSISTENT LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE FLOW INTO THE HIGH TERRAIN COUPLED WITH INCREASING DIVERGENCE ALOFT IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE EXIT REGION OF THE MID TO UPPER-LEVEL JET STREAKS LIFTING OUT OF THE TROUGH BASE WILL FOSTER AN INCREASE IN TSTMS TODAY ALONG AND TO THE N OF THE STALLED SURFACE FRONT. FORECAST HODOGRAPHS EXHIBIT PRONOUNCED VEERING OF WINDS WITH HEIGHT WITH 45-55 KT EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AND EFFECTIVE SRH VALUES OF 150-250 M2/S2 WHICH WILL RESULT IN A VERY FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND TORNADOES.

sections.title: GREAT LAKES TO WRN NEW ENGLAND THIS AFTERNOON THROUGH TONIGHT
sections.text: AS MENTIONED IN THE SYNOPSIS...A MIGRATORY SHORT-WAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED SURFACE LOW WILL TRACK FROM THE UPPER GREAT LAKES TO NEW ENGLAND...ENHANCING FORCING FOR ASCENT AND VERTICAL SHEAR ALONG AND S OF THE SYSTEM PATH. MOREOVER...A RIBBON OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /I.E. 700-500-MB LAPSE RATE OF AROUND 7 C PER KM/ WILL ATTEND THIS SHORT-WAVE TROUGH...COMBINING WITH BOUNDARY-LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S TO AROUND 70F TO PROMOTING AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500+ J/KG ACROSS THE WARM SECTOR. LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS THAT THE REMNANT COLD POOL ASSOCIATED WITH A DECAYING MCS OVER LOWER MI AND/OR THE COLD FRONT TRAILING THE SURFACE LOW WILL BE THE FOCUS FOR SURFACE-BASED TSTM DEVELOPMENT BY AFTERNOON ACROSS SERN LOWER MI. STORMS WILL SUBSEQUENTLY GROW UPSCALE INTO A BROADLY BOWING QLCS WHICH WILL SPREAD EWD/SEWD THROUGH THE LOWER GREAT LAKES AND UPPER OH VALLEY...WITH THIS SYSTEM EVENTUALLY MOVING INTO PARTS OF NEW ENGLAND AND PERHAPS THE NRN MID ATLANTIC REGION LATER THIS EVENING INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS. DAMAGING WINDS WILL LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD WITH THESE STORMS...THOUGH LARGE HAIL AND/OR A BRIEF TORNADO REMAIN POSSIBLE.

sections.title: MIDWEST THIS AFTERNOON INTO TONIGHT
sections.text: THOUGH MIDLEVEL HEIGHTS WILL BE RISING IN THE WAKE OF THE GREAT LAKES IMPULSE...AND DOWNSTREAM OF THE WRN U.S. TROUGH...MODEL GUIDANCE IS SUGGESTIVE THAT A WEAK PERTURBATION OVER THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS THIS MORNING WILL TRANSLATE INTO THE MID MO VALLEY BY THIS EVENING. DCVA ATTENDANT TO THIS FEATURE COUPLED WITH PERSISTENT WAA TO THE N OF THE STALLED SURFACE FRONT ARE EXPECTED TO PROMOTE WIDELY SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT BY LATE AFTERNOON OR EARLY EVENING OVER SRN MN OR NRN IA. SIMILAR TO MONDAY...12Z REGION SOUNDINGS SAMPLED VERY STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /I.E. 700-500-MB LAPSE RATES OF 9.0-9.5 C PER KM/ WHICH OVERLIE A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WITH LOWEST-100-MB MEAN-MIXING RATIOS OF AROUND 15 G/KG WHICH WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE OF 4000-5000 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY WILL ALIGN WITH A VERTICALLY VEERING WIND PROFILE WITH 40-50 KT OF EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WHICH WILL BE QUITE CONDUCIVE FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES WITHIN THE FIRST FEW HOURS OF STORM INITIATION. WITH TIME...COALESCING STORM-SCALE COLD POOLS WILL PROMOTE UPSCALE CONVECTIVE GROWTH INTO A SWD OR SEWD-MOVING MCS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL INTO TONIGHT. ..MEAD/MOSIER.. 06/17

outlooks.summary: ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS WITH DAMAGING WIND...VERY LARGE HAIL...AND FEW TORNADOES ARE EXPECTED FROM EASTERN MONTANA...NORTHEAST WYOMING...AND THE WESTERN DAKOTAS INTO THE MIDWEST. DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS WITH STORMS FROM THE GREAT LAKES TO WESTERN NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: NORTHERN PLAINS INTO UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS CENTRAL/ERN SD INTO N/NERN NEB APPEARS TO BE SOMEWHAT CONDITIONAL THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING. WHILE A VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS EXISTS ACROSS THE REGION WITH MLCAPE GREATER THAN 2000 J/KG IN PLACE...STRONG CAPPING REMAINS. THIS IS DUE IN PART TO CLOUD COVER LIMITING SFC HEATING...WITH CURRENT TEMPERATURES IN THE 70S TO NEAR 80 F ACROSS MUCH OF SD INTO N-CNTRL NEB. FURTHER COMPLICATING THE SETUP ACROSS THIS AREA IS A SHORTWAVE IMPULSE NOTED ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY AND EVIDENT IN FORECAST MODEL GUIDANCE CURRENTLY TRACKING NEWD ACROSS CNTRL/ERN NEB. THE POOR TIMING OF THIS FEATURE MAY RESULT IN MIDLEVEL SUBSIDENCE OVER PARTS OF SD/NEB DURING PEAK HEATING WHEN THE BEST CHANCE OF ERODING THE CAP WOULD OCCUR. DESPITE THESE LIMITING FACTORS...INCREASING LOW LEVEL FLOW ALONG STALLED SFC BOUNDARY AND AN INCREASING LLJ THIS EVENING IN THE VICINITY OF THE SFC DRYLINE MAY BE ADEQUATE FOR A STORM OR TWO TO DEVELOP IN THE MOIST/UNSTABLE AIRMASS. IF STORMS DO DEVELOP...THEY WOULD POSE A LARGE HAIL THREAT. MORE LIKELY...THE SHORTWAVE IMPULSE WILL PROVIDE DEEP LAYER ASCENT FOR DEVELOPMENT ACROSS MN/IA LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO THIS EVENING. AS THE SWLY LLJ STRENGTHENS THIS ACTIVITY S

FARTHER EAST...DAMAGING WIND AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY SEVERE WEATHER THREATS WITH STORMS FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES TO WESTERN NEW ENGLAND.

sections.title: ERN MT/NERN WY/FAR WRN ND/SD/NRN NEB
sections.text: A CORRIDOR OF MODERATE INSTABILITY IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST FROM ERN MT THROUGH NERN WY AND WRN SD THIS FORECAST PERIOD. NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT WILL REMAIN LIKELY THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS AS LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE INCREASES INVOF AN EWD MOVING COLD FRONT AS IT MERGES WITH A QUASI-STATIONARY BOUNDARY CURRENTLY EXTENDING FROM HOOKER AND WRN CHERRY COUNTIES NEB NWWD THROUGH FAR WRN SD AND ERN MT. OUTFLOW FROM ONGOING CONVECTION ALONG THIS LATTER BOUNDARY WAS AIDING IN SOME WWD MOVEMENT THIS SURFACE FEATURE. STRENGTHENING SSWLY 500 MB WINDS TO 60-70 KT ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS ARE EXPECTED THROUGH TONIGHT ATTENDANT TO A MIDLEVEL IMPULSE...NOW LOCATED IN NERN NV/NRN UT...MOVES INTO THE ERN PERIPHERY OF THE NRN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST CLOSED LOW. SUBSEQUENT STRENGTHENING OF ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE EXPECTED FROM THE WRN DAKOTAS INTO ERN MT/NERN WY. GIVEN THE STRENGTHENING WIND FIELDS...EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL REMAIN STRONG WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL SUPERCELLS WITH ALL SEVERE HAZARDS POSSIBLE...INCLUDING VERY LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO THREAT. POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR LINE SEGMENTS TO EVENTUALLY DEVELOP...TRACKING NWD ACROSS ERN MT...AND SOME THREAT FOR A LINE OF

sections.title: NERN NEB/SERN SD/IA/SRN MN/WI TO SRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH ERN NEB...WILL PROGRESS ENEWD INTO NRN IA/SRN MN THIS EVENING...AND THEN TURN EWD INTO WI LATER TONIGHT. ASCENT WITH THIS FEATURE AND A STRENGTHENING SWLY LLJ /45-60 KT/ EXTENDING INTO ERN NEB/IA LATER THIS EVENING THROUGH TONIGHT WITHIN AN EXTREMELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT SUPPORT EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE MCS/S. REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY AND LIGHTNING DATA SHOWED A STORM HAD ALREADY DEVELOPED OVER FAR NERN NEB /CEDAR COUNTY/ INVOF A WARM FRONT. GIVEN THE EXTREME INSTABILITY...STRONG BULK SHEAR AND EFFECTIVE SRH AROUND 200 M2/S2...THE POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR VERY LARGE HAIL AND A TORNADO THREAT. THIS OUTLOOK HAS INTRODUCED A SIGNIFICANT TORNADO POTENTIAL FROM FAR NERN NEB...FAR SERN SD...AND ADJACENT NORTHWEST IA. IN ADDITION...THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND STRENGTHENING LLJ INTO IA SUGGESTS SIGNIFICANT WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS NWRN INTO NRN IA WITH AN MCS DEVELOPMENT INTO THIS AREA. ADDITIONAL STORMS MAY DEVELOP DOWNSTREAM INTO SERN MN TO SRN WI...OR AN MCS FROM SRN MN/NRN IA WILL MOVE EWD INTO SRN WI AND NRN IL LATER TONIGHT WITH DAMAGING WINDS THE PRIMARY THREAT.

sections.title: LOWER GREAT LAKES THROUGH NY/NRN PA TO WRN NEW ENGLAND
sections.text: AN ONGOING BAND OF STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS CURRENTLY MOVING INTO FAR WRN NY...FAR NWRN PA AND NERN OH WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL AS THIS ACTIVITY MOVES EWD THROUGH A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND STRONGLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT. ..PETERS.. 06/18/2014

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS EXPECTED TO INCREASE ACROSS ERN LOWER MI OVER THE NEXT HOUR...BUT LIMITED TEMPORAL AND SPATIAL EXTEND OF THE THREAT SUGGESTS THAT WW WILL LIKELY BE UNNECESSARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SURFACE OBS AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES REVEAL CONTINUED DIURNAL HEATING OF A MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER IN PLACE ACROSS THE AREA...WHICH HAS CONTRIBUTED TO DEVELOPMENT OF 1000 TO 2000 J/KG MIXED-LAYER CAPE EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. WHILE ONGOING CONVECTION CONTINUES TO SHIFT INTO LK HURON...SOME INCREASE IN CU -- PER WV IMAGERY -- IS INDICATED ACROSS THE THUMB REGION AND SWD TOWARD DET ATTM. WINDS ACROSS WRN AND CENTRAL LOWER MI HAVE VEERED OVER THE PAST HOUR TO SWLY/WSWLY...WHILE MORE SSWLY FLOW PERSISTS ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF THE STATE -- THUS YIELDING AN INCREASE IN LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE. THUS -- POTENTIAL FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT IS EVIDENT...WITH SEVERE RISK BOLSTERED BY FAVORABLY STRONG WSWLY FLOW ALOFT ACROSS THE AREA. THAT SAID...EXPECT THE RISK TO REMAIN SHORT-LIVED...AS ANY DEVELOPING STORMS WOULD MOVE QUICKLY EWD INTO LAKE HURON/SRN ONTARIO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A GRADUAL INCREASE IN CONVECTION IS ONGOING ACROSS WRN NY AND VICINITY...WITH WW TO BECOME INCREASINGLY LIKELY WITH TIME THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING/MOVING ACROSS LK ONTARIO AND ADJACENT WRN NY...THROUGH A MOIST AIRMASS THAT CONTINUES TO HEAT/DESTABILIZE. WHILE MORE WIDESPREAD/SUBSTANTIAL CONVECTION IS FORECAST TO EXIT SRN ONTARIO AND MOVE INTO THIS AREA LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING -- WITH A WW LIKELY TO BE REQUIRED...ISOLATED STORMS ONGOING ATTM COULD ALSO POSE ISOLATED SEVERE RISK GIVEN THE BACKGROUND KINEMATIC AND THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT. WE WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION ACROSS THIS AREA...WITH RESPECT TO APPROPRIATE TIMING FOR EVENTUAL WW ISSUANCE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM INITIATION IS EXPECTED WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. MODERATE INSTABILITY COUPLED WITH MODERATE TO STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR AND AT LEAST MODERATE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL RESULT IN SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF ALL SEVERE THREATS...INCLUDING TORNADOES. WW LIKELY BY 20Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY HAS RECENTLY SHOWN BETTER CU DEVELOPMENT ALONG A FRONTAL BOUNDARY EXTENDING FROM CUSTER COUNTY MT SWD INTO CONVERSE COUNTY WY. ENVIRONMENT THROUGHOUT THIS AREA CONTINUES TO DESTABILIZE WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50S TO LOW 60S BENEATH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES PROMOTING MLCAPE FROM 1000 TO 2000 J PER KG. STRONGEST SHEAR CURRENTLY EXISTS A BIT FARTHER W FROM THIS AREA OF DESTABILIZATION BUT SHOULD GRADUALLY MOVE EWD AS THE MAIN UPPER LOW SLOWLY TRACKS EWD. CONTINUED DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION IN TANDEM WITH INCREASING LARGE SCALE LIFT IS EXPECTED TO RESULT IN CONVECTIVE INITIATION WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. JUXTAPOSITION OF INSTABILITY AND STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR /0-6 KM BULK SHEAR AROUND 40 TO 50 KT/ WILL LIKELY RESULT IN SUPERCELLS. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS BUT BACKED LOW-LEVEL FLOW COULD SUPPORT A FEW TORNADOES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORM DEVELOPMENT -- AND ACCOMPANYING SEVERE RISK -- MAY DEVELOP IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA. WW POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS INCREASING CU DEVELOPMENT ALONG A REMNANT CONVECTIVE BOUNDARY STRETCHING FROM SRN LOWER MI WSWWD ACROSS NRN INDIANA INTO NRN IL. THE MOIST AIRMASS NEAR AND S OF THIS BOUNDARY CONTINUES TO HEAT/DESTABILIZE...WITH 2500 TO 3000 J/KG NOW INDICATED PER OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS. WITH FLOW ACROSS THIS REGION INCREASING WITH HEIGHT WHILE VEERING GRADUALLY FROM SWWD TO WWD/WNWWD THROUGH THE LOWEST 4 KM...SHEAR WOULD SUPPORT VIGOROUS/EWD-MOVING STORMS. WHILE INITIAL STORM MOTION ALONG THE BOUNDARY WOULD YIELD SOME CONVECTIVE INTERFERENCE -- NOT IDEAL FOR SUSTAINED SEVERE RISK...DEGREE OF CAPE SUGGEST THAT UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A BOWING MCS IS AT LEAST A POSSIBILITY. WE WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR EVOLUTION OF THE CU FIELD ACROSS THIS AREA FOR SIGNS THAT WW MAY BECOME NECESSARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES ACROSS WW 311 WITH SOME ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT EXTENDING S OF THE WATCH INTO THE NEB PANHANDLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS SEVERAL SUPERCELLS HAVE DEVELOPED IN E-CNTRL MT. TSTM COVERAGE WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...PARTICULARLY ACROSS SE MT SEWD TOWARDS THE NEB PANHANDLE...AS LARGE-SCALE LIFT AND CONVERGENCE ALONG THE FRONTAL BOUNDARY PERSIST. THE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH BULK SHEAR EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE AS THE UPPER LOW OVER ID CONTINUES TO DRIFT EWD. AS SUCH...SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND TORNADOES REMAIN POSSIBLE. ADDITIONALLY...AN ISOLATED SUPERCELL IS POSSIBLE S OF THE WATCH /SW SD...NEB PANHANDLE/. COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED...WHICH WOULD PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW...BUT TRENDS ACROSS THE AREA WILL BE MONITORED. ..MOSIER.. 06/17/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INITIATE OVER NERN NEB...SERN SD OR NWRN IA BY 00Z. SUPERCELLS WITH VERY LARGE HAIL AND A FEW TORNADOES WILL BE INITIAL PRIMARY THREATS, BUT THE THREAT FOR MORE WIDESPREAD DAMAGING WIND WILL INCREASE THROUGH THE EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLY THIS EVENING A WARM FRONT EXTENDS FROM EXTREME NRN NEB INTO SERN SD THEN SEWD THROUGH NRN IA. ELEVATED MIXED LAYER WITH VERY STEEP /8.5-9 C/KM/ 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES HAVE ADVECTED ABOVE THE AXIS OF RICH GULF MOISTURE THAT EXISTS IN VICINITY OF AND SOUTH OF THIS BOUNDARY RESULTING IN 3000-4000 J/KG MLCAPE. VISIBLE SATELLITE SHOWS CUMULUS INCREASING ALONG THE FRONT...ESPECIALLY FROM NERN NEB INTO SERN SD AND EXTREME NWRN IA...WHILE WV IMAGERY SHOWS WHAT APPEARS TO BE A SHORTWAVE TROUGH LIFTING NEWD THROUGH THE CNTRL PLAINS. DEEPER FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH APPROACHING SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND STRENGTHENING LLJ WILL AUGMENT MESOSCALE ASCENT ALONG THE FRONT...EVENTUALLY RESULTING IN THUNDERSTORM INITIATION EARLY THIS EVENING. WINDS ARE ESELY IN VICINITY OF THE FRONT WITH VEERING LOW-LEVEL WINDS AND UP TO 40 KT DEEP SHEAR. UPDRAFTS INITIATING WITHIN THIS ENVIRONMENT WILL LIKELY UNDERGO EXPLOSIVE DEVELOPMENT GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY. STORMS SHOULD MOVE EWD WHERE THEY WILL INTERACT WITH ZONE OF ENHANCED VORTICITY ALONG THE BOUNDARY...AUGMENTING THE THREAT FOR LOW-LEVEL MESOCYCLONES AND TORNADOES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP EWD THROUGH WRN NY AND EVENTUALLY NWRN PA. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS...BUT A COUPLE TORNADOES CANNOT BE RULED OUT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE DEVELOPED OVER SERN CANADA IN ASSOCIATION WITH A COLD FRONT AND PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING THROUGH THE GREAT LAKES AREA. THE DOWNSTREAM ATMOSPHERE OVER THE NERN U.S. REMAINS MODERATELY UNSTABLE...AND A BELT OF STRONGER WINDS ACCOMPANYING THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL SPREAD EWD OVER THE WARM SECTOR WITH UP TO 45 KT OF DEEP SHEAR. SUPERCELLS ARE LIKELY. HOWEVER...LINES AND BOWING SEGMENTS SHOULD EVENTUALLY BECOME THE DOMINANT MODE...BUT WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: INCREASING PROBABILITY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS FOR VERY LARGE HAIL WITH A FEW INTENSE SUPERCELLS. THE SUPERCELL TORNADO THREAT WILL PROBABLY INCREASE THROUGH THE EARLY EVENING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 22Z SURFACE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS INTO THE GREATER BLACK HILLS VICINITY TO THE E OF A DRYLINE. THE DRYLINE WILL PROBABLY SERVE AS AN AREA FOR PREFERRED STORM INITIATION OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. MODIFYING THE 18Z RAP RAOB SHOWS EXTREME VALUES OF MLCAPE /3500-4500 J PER KG/ OVER WRN SD AND INTO N-CNTRL NEB. RELATIVELY COOL H5 TEMPS -13 PER THE RAP RAOB ARE CONTRIBUTING TO VERY LARGE CAPE IN THE -10 TO -30 DEG C LAYER GIVEN THE STEEP LAPSE RATE PROFILE. ELY WINDS STRONGLY VEERING IN THE LOW-LEVELS WITH STRONG/INCREASING FLOW ALOFT IS FAVORING A DISCRETE SUPERCELL MODE. GIVEN THE EXTREME CAPE AND STRONG SHEAR...EXPECTING VERY LARGE /I.E. 2-3 INCHES IN DIAMETER/ TO ACCOMPANY THE MOST INTENSE SUPERCELLS. THE TORNADO THREAT MAY INCREASE WITH ANY SUPERCELL DURING THE EARLY EVENING HOURS IN RESPONSE TO AN INTENSIFICATION IN H85 FLOW. ..SMITH.. 06/17/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO POTENTIAL AND THE POSSIBILITY FOR A STRONG TORNADO...INCLUDING A THREAT FOR VERY LARGE TO GIANT HAIL...WILL PROBABLY MAXIMIZE DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE 17/00Z RAP RAOB SHOWED EXTREME BUOYANCY /4100 J PER KG MLCAPE/ AND A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER CHARACTERIZED BY A 14-15 LOWEST 100 MB MEAN MIXING RATIO. A SUPERCELL WIND PROFILE WILL CONTINUE TO LEND A WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY FOR VERY LARGE TO GIANT HAIL /I.E. 2-4 INCHES IN DIAMETER/ AND TORNADO POTENTIAL FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. INPUTTING THE OBSERVED STORM MOTION OF THE BUTTE COUNTY SUPERCELL INTO THE KUDX VWP YIELDS AROUND 300 M2/S2 0-3 KM SRH AND THIS MAY SIGNAL THAT THE POSSIBILITY FOR A STRONG TORNADO MAY MAXIMIZE OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. IN ADDITION TO THE HAIL/TORNADO THREAT...A SEVERE WIND GUST WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE INVOF ANY SUPERCELL. K2WX OBSERVED A MEASURED 61 KT GUST AROUND 0008Z IN HARDING COUNTY WITH THE NRN OF THE 2 DISCRETE SUPERCELLS. ..SMITH.. 06/18/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY DEVELOP OVER SRN MN INTO WRN WI AND POSE A THREAT FOR MAINLY LARGE HAIL. CONVECTIVE AND MESOSCALE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE IMAGERY INDICATES WHAT APPEARS TO BE AN AREA OF DEEPENING CONVECTION ROOTED ABOVE THE SFC LAYER FROM NRN IA INTO SERN MN AND WCNTRL WI TO THE NORTH OF AN E-W ORIENTED WARM FRONT. THIS ACTIVITY APPEARS TO BE IN RESPONSE TO INCREASING ISENTROPIC ASCENT NORTH OF THIS BOUNDARY ON NOSE OF A SWLY LLJ. EVENING RAOB FROM MINNEAPOLIS STILL SHOWED A WEAK INVERSION BASED NEAR 650 MB...BUT POTENTIAL FOR DEEP FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDING A NEWD EJECTING SHORTWAVE TROUGH AS WELL AS ISENTROPIC ASCENT NORTH OF THE WARM FRONT MAY FURTHER WEAKEN THE CAPPING INVERSION...RESULTING IN DEEP CONVECTION. MOST STORMS THAT DEVELOP WILL PROBABLY BE SLIGHTLY ELEVATED...BUT STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 30-35 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR WOULD SUPPORT LARGE HAIL. ANY STORMS DEVELOPING IN CLOSER PROXIMITY TO THE BOUNDARY OVER NRN IA MAY BECOME ROOTED IN THE NEAR SFC LAYER...AND THESE STORMS COULD POSE A THREAT FOR A TORNADO IN ADDITION TO LARGE HAIL SHOULD THEY DEVELOP.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND AND LARGE HAIL WILL PERSIST NEXT FEW HOURS ACROSS WRN/CNTRL NY THROUGH NRN PA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MIXED MODE OF STORMS INCLUDING LINES AND A FEW DISCRETE SUPERCELLS PERSIST FROM NWRN PA THROUGH WRN NY. THE LINE ACROSS NWRN NY IS MOVING EAST AT NEAR 50 KT AND WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR STRONG TO DAMAGING WIND GUSTS NEXT HOUR OR TWO. OTHERWISE...EVENING RAOB DATA FROM BUFFALO SHOWED STRONG SWLY-WLY FLOW IN THE 850-500 MB LAYER AND 20C NEAR SFC TEMPERATURE-DEWPOINT SPREADS...BUT MODEST INSTABILITY. OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SHOWS AN AXIS OF 1000-1500 J/KG IMMEDIATELY DOWNSTREAM FROM THE DEVELOPING STORMS. POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE WEATHER WILL LIKELY PERSIST NEXT 2-3 HOURS BEFORE ACTIVITY BEGINS TO UNDERGO AN OVERALL DECREASE IN RESPONSE TO A STABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: VERY STRONG LOW-LEVEL ROTATIONAL VELOCITIES LIKELY INDICATIVE OF A VIOLENT TORNADO. THE NEAR-STORM ENVIRONMENT REMAINS VERY SUPPORTIVE FOR INTENSE TORNADOES FOR THE NEXT HOUR OR MORE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: KOAX RADAR IMAGERY SHOWS PEAK 0.5 DEG ROTATIONAL VELOCITIES 90+ KT SUPPORTING A HIGH PROBABILITY /60 PERCENT OR GREATER/ FOR A VIOLENT TORNADO BASED ON RADAR ALONE. THE 00Z OMA RAOB SHOWED A AN EXTREMELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS AND LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS BEGINNING TO INCREASE PER KOAX VWP DATA. INPUTTING THE CEDAR COUNTY TORNADIC SUPERCELL MOTION YIELDS OVER 300 M2/S2 0-3 KM SRH. EXPECTING A CONTINUED THREAT FOR INTENSE TORNADOES /EF3+/ FOR THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. ..SMITH.. 06/18/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE THREAT FOR STORMS AND ISOLD SEVERE IS INCREASING THIS EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WINDS APPEAR TO BE THE PRIMARY THREATS...ALTHOUGH A TORNADO IS NOT OUT OF THE QUESTION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC AT 0235Z SHOWS SEVERAL SMALL CLUSTERS OF STORMS EXTENDING IN A WEST TO EAST ORIENTATION FROM FAR ERN IA AND ALONG THE WI/IL BORDER. THE UPDRAFTS TO THE W OF LAKE MICH MAY BE ORIGINATING IN A LAYER ATOP THE BOUNDARY LAYER. THE DVN RAOB SHOWED A WARM NOSE AT H75 AND IT MAY AT LEAST TEMPORALLY IF NOT LARGELY INHIBIT SURFACE-BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT. NONETHELESS...A WARM FRONTAL ZONE DRAPED ACROSS THE REGION WITH VERY MOIST LOW LEVELS OVER THE REGION HAS CONTRIBUTED TO VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS THAT IS CHARACTERIZED BY 2000-3500 J/KG MLCAPE. MODERATE WLY FLOW ATOP SLY SURFACE WINDS IS SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED STORM STRUCTURES...MAINLY IN THE FORM OF STRONG TO SEVERE MULTICELLS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS. THE NOSE OF A 30-40 KT LLJ WILL PROBABLY REMAIN OVER THE ERN IA/NRN IL VICINITY AND FAVOR ADDITIONAL STORMS THIS EVENING. THE MAIN HAZARDS ASSOCIATED WITH ANY ACTIVITY THAT CAN MATURE/STRENGTHEN WOULD LIKELY BE ISOLD LARGE HAIL/DMGG WINDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR TORNADOES...VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL PERSIST NEXT COUPLE HOURS FROM NERN NEB...NWRN IA...SERN SD AND SWRN MN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ROTATIONAL VELOCITIES INDICATE THE CYCLIC TORNADIC SUPERCELL OVER EXTREME NERN NEB IS LIKELY STILL PRODUCING A STRONG TORNADO AS OF 0315Z. ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE DEVELOPING OVER SERN SD INTO NWRN IA JUST NORTH OF AN E-W ORIENTED QUASI-STATIONARY FRONT. DESPITE THE ONSET OF NOCTURNAL COOLING...THE ATMOSPHERE REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE IN THIS REGION. A VERY MOIST WARM SECTOR WITH LOW 70S DEWPOINTS IS DELAYING THE TENDENCY FOR THE BOUNDARY LAYER TO DECOUPLE...AND NEW STORMS DEVELOPING ARE LIKELY STILL SURFACE BASED. THE VWP FROM SIOUX FALLS SHOWS VEERING LOW-LEVEL WINDS WITH 0-2 KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITY AROUND 200 M2/S2...SUGGESTING THE THREAT FOR LOW-LEVEL MESOCYCLONES AND TORNADOES STILL EXISTS IN ADDITION TO VERY LARGE HAIL. ..DIAL.. 06/18/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLD LARGE HAIL THREAT MAY INCREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR MOSAIC SHOWS INTENSIFYING STORMS OVER NRN WI AND THE PRICE COUNTY WISCONSIN STORM HAS A HISTORY OF PRODUCING HAIL PER WDSS-II MESH IMAGERY. ADDITIONAL SHOWERS AND INTENSIFYING CONVECTION ARE EVIDENT FARTHER WEST IN S-CNTRL MN AS ISENTROPIC ASCENT LIFTS PARCELS TO THEIR LFC. THE WIND PROFILE IS SUPERCELL-SUPPORTIVE AND THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS MAY ACQUIRE STORM-SCALE ROTATION. STRONG ELEVATED INSTABILITY /2500 J PER KG MUCAPE/ ACCORDING TO THE 00Z MPX RAOB WILL AID IN THE POTENTIAL FOR A LARGE HAIL THREAT AS A WARM FRONTAL ZONE GRADUALLY ADVANCES NWD TONIGHT. THEREFORE EXPECTING ADDITIONAL STRONG TO SEVERE HAIL-PRODUCING STORMS TO DEVELOP.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADIC SUPERCELLS CONTINUE TO SHOW STRONG SUPPORTING EVIDENCE FOR PRODUCING STRONG TO PERHAPS VIOLENT STRENGTH TORNADOES.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: KFSD AND KOAX RADAR IMAGERY OVER THE PAST 30 MINUTES HAVE SHOWN 0.5 DEG TILT PEAK ROTATIONAL VELOCITIES OF 55-95 KT. THE MINNEHAHA COUNTY STORM HAS OR IS LIKELY PRODUCING A VIOLENT TORNADO /60 PERCENT OR GREATER PROBABILITY/ AS OF 0355Z BASED ON ROTATIONAL VELOCITY ALONE. INPUTTING THE OBSERVED STORM MOTIONS FOR THE TORNADIC SUPERCELLS YIELDS AROUND 300 M2/S2 0-3 KM SRH. THE NEAR-STORM ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY LOWER-MID 70S DEWPOINTS AND VERY LARGE CAPE WILL SUPPORT A CONTINUED RISK FOR STRONG TO VIOLENT TORNADOES FOR AT LEAST THE NEXT 30-60 MINUTES IF NOT LONGER. ..SMITH.. 06/18/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 315 WILL LIKELY NEED TO BE REPLACED BY ANOTHER TORNADO WATCH THAT WILL EXTEND FARTHER EAST TO INCLUDE MORE OF SRN MN AND NRN IA IN ADDITION TO NERN NEB AND SERN SD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS DISCRETE STORMS CONTINUE DEVELOPING WITHIN A VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND A STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. THE NEAR SFC LAYER HAS NOT YET DECOUPLED...AND VWPS SHOW LARGE HODOGRAPHS IN VICINITY OF A STATIONARY FRONT. THUS STORMS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES IN ADDITION TO LARGE HAIL NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS MAY CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND NEXT HOUR OR TWO ACROSS SERN NY INTO WRN MA. HOWEVER...OVERALL TREND SHOULD BE FOR STORMS TO BEGIN A WEAKENING TREND AFTER 0530Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF STORMS CONTINUES MOVING THROUGH ERN NY AND APPROACHING SRN NEW ENGLAND. STORMS REMAIN EMBEDDED WITHIN BELT OF STRONG WLY DEEP LAYER WINDS ASSOCIATED WITH A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH. HOWEVER...THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO STABILIZE RESULTING IN AN INCREASINGLY MARGINAL THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...ESPECIALLY WITH EWD EXTENT INTO SRN NEW ENGLAND. THEREFORE...STORMS SHOULD BEGIN AN OVERALL WEAKENING TREND WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO. ..DIAL.. 06/18/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PER COORDINATION WITH WFO/S MKX/LOT...WW 318 HAS BEEN REDEFINED NWD WITHIN THE LOW-LEVEL WAA CORRIDOR ALONG/N OF THE SURFACE WARM FRONT ARCING FROM FAR SE MN INTO FAR SW LOWER MI. WW ISSUANCE REMAINS POSSIBLE FOR A RISK OF MAINLY SEVERE HAIL TO THE N/E.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTM CLUSTERS HAVE BECOME CONFINED ACROSS CNTRL/S WI TO S LK MI...ALONG/N OF AN ARCING WARM FRONT FROM NEAR RST TO MSN TO AZO. ALTHOUGH A RESERVOIR OF MODERATE TO STRONG POTENTIAL BUOYANCY WILL RESIDE S OF THE FRONT...GREATER INHIBITION AND LACK OF APPRECIABLE LARGE-SCALE ASCENT BEYOND WAA WILL PROBABLY PRECLUDE DEVELOPMENT SWD IN THE NEAR-TERM. FARTHER N...ISENTROPIC LIFT SHOULD CONTINUE TO FOSTER CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS WITH A RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL MOST PROMINENT IN INITIAL CELLULAR UPDRAFTS...GIVEN MODEST SPEED SHEAR EVIDENT AOA 3 KM AGL IN GRB VWP DATA. WITH TIME...MANY OF THESE CELLS SHOULD CONGLOMERATE...BUT THE RISK FOR SEVERE WINDS MAY BE SUBDUED BY LACK OF ROBUST LLJ AND COOLER/MORE STABLE AIR MASS OVER MOST OF LOWER MI.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM CLUSTERS SHOULD PERSIST THROUGH MOST OF THE EARLY MORNING...WELL BEYOND 07Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION OF WW 317. HOWEVER...OVERALL SEVERE RISK APPEARS TO BE MARGINAL AND MAY NOT WARRANT A REPLACEMENT WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT MID-LEVEL REFLECTIVITY TRENDS SUGGEST TSTM CLUSTERS OVER W SD HAVE WEAKENED. THIS SUGGESTS SEVERE HAIL RISK SHOULD BE MARGINAL GIVEN CONSTANT TO SLIGHTLY WEAKER WINDS WITH HEIGHT AOA 3 KM AGL IN UDX VWP DATA. STILL...LOW-LEVEL WAA/VEERING OF THE WIND PROFILE AMIDST MIDDLE 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS WILL FAVOR REGENERATIVE STORMS WITH LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND GUSTS AS THE PRIMARY RISK. WITH THE MORE ROBUST SWLY LLJ EXPECTED TO REMAIN ACROSS THE CNTRL PLAINS TO MID-MO VALLEY...OVERALL INTENSITY OF THE CLUSTER DOES NOT APPEAR LIKELY TO INCREASE SUBSTANTIALLY. ..GRAMS.. 06/18/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST NEAR-TERM SEVERE RISK EXISTS WITH SUPERCELL CLUSTER OVER NW IA. ADDITIONAL UPDRAFTS MAY FORM SW/NE AND MERGE WITH TSTM CLUSTERS OVER S-CNTRL MN TO YIELD A DEEPENING COLD POOL OVER N IA/S MN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SUPERCELL OVER CLAY COUNTY HAD INTENSE LOW-LEVEL ROTATION THAT WEAKENED SUBSTANTIALLY IN THE HALF-HOUR...AS FLANKING UPDRAFTS DEVELOPED TO THE W IN O'BRIEN COUNTY. WARM SECTOR TO THE S OF THIS ACTIVITY REMAINS VERY UNSTABLE PER 04Z OAX RAOB AND WITH A 50-60 KT SWLY LLJ PER OAX/UEX VWP DATA...ROBUST REGENERATIVE UPDRAFTS APPEAR PROBABLE ATOP CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW/EFFECTIVE FRONTAL BOUNDARY. CONGLOMERATION OF THESE UPDRAFTS WILL LIKELY FOSTER A DEEPENING COLD POOL ALONG THE IA/MN BORDER. ALTHOUGH MID/UPPER-LEVEL WINDS ARE RELATIVELY WEAK FOR A ROBUST FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS...AT LEAST AN ISOLATED SEVERE WIND RISK MAY PERSIST FOR SEVERAL HOURS. ..GRAMS.. 06/18/2014 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: DEVELOPING MCS WITH A HISTORY OF WIND DAMAGE AND MEASURED WIND GUSTS OF 40-47 KT...APPEARS TO BE IN THE PROCESS OF ACCELERATING EWD AS IT APPROACHES THE I-35 CORRIDOR IN N-CNTRL IA. WITH A STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS PERSISTING S OF THIS ACTIVITY AMIDST WIDESPREAD 71-73 DEG F SURFACE DEW POINTS...THE MCS SHOULD PROPAGATE E ALONG THE PERIPHERY OF THE MID-MO VALLEY SWLY LLJ. mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED SEVERE RISK CONTINUES NEAR-TERM WITH A SLOW-MOVING AND LIKELY WEAKENING MCV OVER N-CNTRL SD. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE BLACK HILLS MAY INTENSIFY INTO WEAK SUPERCELLS/CLUSTERS CAPABLE OF PRIMARILY SEVERE HAIL/WIND.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL CLUSTER OF STORMS WITH AN EMBEDDED MCV HAS PROGRESSED GRADUALLY E/NE AT AROUND 15-25 KT OVER THE MO VALLEY OF N-CNTRL SD. THE SRN UPDRAFT OF THIS CLUSTER HAS HAD A PERSISTENT SEVERE HAIL SIGNATURE IN WDSS-II MESH ALGORITHMS. GIVEN RELATIVELY MODEST DEEP-LAYER SHEAR /0-6 KM OF NEAR 25 KT/ EVIDENT IN BIS VWP DATA...OVERALL SEVERE RISK SHOULD WANE WITH THIS CLUSTER. FARTHER SW...CONTINUED LOW-LEVEL WAA/20-KT ELY UPSLOPE HAS FOSTERED RENEWED STORM DEVELOPMENT OVER PARTS OF THE BLACK HILLS. WITH THE NW PERIPHERY OF MIDDLE 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS REMAINING ALONG AN AXIS FROM CDR-PHP-PIR...WEAK TO MODERATE BUOYANCY IS LIKELY PRESENT ACROSS SW SD. LOW-LEVEL VEERING IN CONJUNCTION WITH WINDS INCREASING WITH HEIGHT AOA 2 KM AGL IN UDX VWP DATA COULD YIELD A FEW SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WITH PRIMARY RISKS OF ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL AND WIND.

mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NRN PORTION OF A QLCS CROSSING THE MS RIVER NEAR LA CROSSE HAS HAD THE TIGHTEST REFLECTIVITY GRADIENT ALONG IT...AS IT ACCELERATED EWD TO AROUND 40-45 KT FORWARD SPEED.
